Maria.AE: BlueMarigold POC asking if we can run marigold-30b on their colo with customer HSM (PKCS#11) and KV prefix caching. They expect ~10 qps sustained. What are the main blockers and rough timeline?

Tony.SE: Short: marigold-30b uses RMSNorm + grouped_gemm. We can serve quantized q8_0 but need conversion + compile. Latency on older runtime will be suboptimal until grouped_gemm kernel is enabled.

Olivia.ML: Estimate: conversion + quantize + compile + smoke perf = 2-3 business days. KV prefix caching supported up to 2k tokens; if they need longer prefixes we should plan kv-shard changes (1 extra day). If they want lower cost, propose marigold-lite (~13B distilled).

Kyle.Infra: On-prem requirements: NVIDIA driver >=525, CUDA >=12.1, pkcs11 libs installed. If they supply 2x A100s it's doable but H100s strongly preferred for latency headroom. Please capture `nvidia-smi` and `ldconfig` output.

Ollie.Security: We support customer HSM via PKCS#11 in Private mode with our KMS adapter. Required items: completed security questionnaire, DPA, network diagram. If they require zero-egress residency, confirm storage encryption at rest and keywrap.

infra-bot: Created INF-9123: run diagnostics on their host:
```
./validate_cuda.sh --min=12.1
ldconfig -p | grep pkcs11 || echo "install pkcs11"
kubectl apply -f redwood-host-check.yaml
```

Maria.AE: Action list: I'll request env dump + RFI. Tony please draft a 10 qps cost ballpark for Dedicated vs Private. Olivia tentatively reserve 3 days for conversion once infra validated. Ollie I'll send RFI when they reply. Thanks :thumbsup:
